calculation.description: Contrarian short-term signal using an exponentially weighted mean of recent daily returns, normalized by exponentially weighted return volatility. Higher values indicate stronger reversal opportunity; cross-sectional median is removed.

validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; minimum 8 valid instruments per date
validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in all three evaluated regimes. The factor has substantially lower turnover and higher coverage than the one-day volatility-scaled reversal while retaining strong daily predictive power. IC and ICIR exceed benchmark gates of absolute IC 0.0070 and absolute ICIR 0.0840.
